items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Doc says, stay back here, tell them.

ctx.x: I know, well, I, at Legends, when the people were dancing, they weren't drinking, so they weren't making money, I figured, that's why they want them to take a break like that. Sure. Yeah.

Yeah, man, you're, like at the hangovers, you know, hangovers in, uh, hangovers in, uh, in San Francisco. Doc, when that kid get packing, packing jam, Doc, Doc, hold a finger like that. Don't know what, he had a light, he turned on the band, and said, a little light, no, boy, no, what the light was, but the band, no? Yeah. Then that light on, man, look at that light. Put that number, we get out. Hmm. I mean, the place is packed with people, let them buy a liquor, you see? They go back in, set in a dress room, you…
What? You ain't got to pay no admission. You don't have to pay that to come in.
